rachel.sec: heads-up: vendor runs a focused pen-test next Thu 09:30-12:30 UTC. goal: auth + KMS flows. proposing containment sandbox in staging and an evidence vault S3 prefix.

omar.sre: agree on staging sandbox. suggest synthetic KMS key + synthetic ciphertext for any decrypt tests. no prod keys.

nina.audit: RBAC snapshot required 36h before window. please include service account bindings and OAuth clients. SIEM needs a bookmark for kms:Decrypt and s3:PutObject.

lee.oncall: I'll own runbook and the live revocation steps. plan: provision ephemeral kms-proxy grants TTL=3h, verify CloudTrail capture, and rotate proxy creds post-window.

rachel.sec: also add a "handoff manifest" in tracker: evidence_bucket, synthetic_key_arn, triage_owner, hotfix_lane boolean. nina, can you own tracker ingestion?

nina.audit: yes. I'll create ticket label pentest/2026-09 and add those fields. please attach RBAC CSV and sample policy.

omar.sre: sample IAM snippet for runbook (will paste later). we'll scope policy to Encrypt/Decrypt on the synthetic key and s3:PutObject to evidence vault only.

pt-bot: PEN-TEST: Assessor "echo-labs" scheduled 2026-09-10T09:30Z. Handshake key uploaded.

lee.oncall: dry-run tonight 19:00 UTC to validate pipeline (lambda copy -> encrypted S3). invite sent.

rachel.sec: retest cadence: vendor asked for two retest slots; prefer Mon or Fri afternoons. omar, can you confirm patch branch policy so we can record commit hashes in ticket?

omar.sre: yes. patches go to staging branch; include commit hash in ticket and evidence for retest.

nina.audit: legal note: any request to access real customer data must be denied and escalated to #incidents. add signed DPA addendum to tracker before key provisioning.

rachel.sec: owners: runbook=lee.oncall; provisioning=omar.sre; intake=nina.audit. if anyone sees scope creep during window, ping me and tag #incidents immediately. :warning:
